comment: Declarative resident state for the ConoHa DEV ROOM node. The supervisor only enables/starts units listed here; it never stops or disables anything. Units with required=false are ignored until they are actually installed, so this file is safe to ship ahead of the units it describes.

units.name: norizo-health.service
units.note: P1 gate. Every resident worker orders itself after this unit.

units.name: norizo-control-agent.service
units.note: P0 control plane. required=false until dev-room-p0-p5 is merged and installed.

units.name: norizo-p1-p5.timer
units.note: Resident P1-P5 executor schedule. Replaces the external ChatGPT Automation scheduler.
